exercises.description: Enemy at x=300, friendly at x=50. Calculate distance using abs(). Print 'SAFE' if distance > 200, else 'DANGER'.
exercises.solution:
enemy_pos = 300
friendly_pos = 50
distance = abs(enemy_pos - friendly_pos)
if distance > 200:
    print('SAFE')
else:
    print('DANGER')

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: 2D Perimeter Defense
exercises.description: CLASSIFIED: Check if drone (x=250, y=150) is in safe zone: X(0-500), Y(0-300). Also check if within 100 units of base (200, 200). Print 'IN BOUNDS' and 'NEAR BASE' or'FAR FROM BASE'.
exercises.starterCode:
import math
# Drone and base coordinates
drone_x, drone_y = 250, 150
base_x, base_y = 200, 200
exercises.solution:
import math
drone_x, drone_y = 250, 150
base_x, base_y = 200, 200

# Boundary check
if 0 <= drone_x <= 500 and 0 <= drone_y <= 300:
    print('IN BOUNDS')
else:
    print('OUT OF BOUNDS')

# Proximity check
distance = math.sqrt((drone_x - base_x)**2 + (drone_y - base_y)**2)
if distance < 100:
    print('NEAR BASE')
else:
    print('FAR FROM BASE')
